cast.HIM: a man in his thirties with short dark hair and a plain mid-grey t-shirt
cast.DOUBLE: an identical man with the exact same face and short dark hair wearing a bright RED t-shirt

shots.action: Pale green clinic. The TURKEY nurse at reception, typing, big enough to read. On the wall a red poster.
shots.change: The place and the product. Plants: the poster, the turkey.
shots.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a small clinic waiting room, eye level, symmetrical. Behind the reception desk a cartoon turkey wearing a small nurse's cap types at a computer, clearly visible, mid-frame. On the back wall a large blank red poster (the only red). A row of empty waiting chairs. Clean, plain, flat front light.

shots.action: HIM in a waiting chair. His fingers drum his knees to a beat only he hears. He hums.
shots.line: (humming)
shots.change: Plant: he hears music no one else can.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, eye level, centred: a man in his thirties with short dark hair and a plain mid-grey t-shirt sits alone in a clinic waiting chair, slightly green-faced, drumming his fingers on his knees, eyes half closed, humming. A blank red poster on the wall behind him (the only red). Locked-off, flat light.

shots.action: The poster, held 2 s so it reads: HAWKES PUNCH. Ask your doctor.
shots.change: Plant: the product's name and the tagline.
shots.prompt: Insert shot, straight on, filling the frame: a red medical advertising poster on a clinic wall (the red is the only colour), with a large bold empty title band and a smaller empty tagline band beneath, a simple fist icon in the middle. Flat, square to camera.

shots.action: The TURKEY turns its head to him. He looks up, stands and goes in. Cut on his movement.
shots.line: TURKEY: Gobble.
shots.change: Turn (+): he is called in.
shots.prompt: Medium shot over the reception counter: a cartoon turkey in a small nurse's cap turns its head toward the waiting area and opens its beak. In the background, out of focus, a dark-haired man in a grey t-shirt rises from his chair. Eye level, plain light.

shots.action: The exam room. HIM on the bed screen left, the window behind him. The DOCTOR at her desk screen right, kind smile. On the wall behind her: a framed pair of red boxing gloves and a plaque.
shots.change: Geography for the whole scene. Plant: the gloves (we see them, he doesn't).
shots.prompt: Wide shot of a doctor's exam room, eye level, symmetrical. Screen left: a dark-haired man in a grey t-shirt sits on the examination bed, a window behind him. Screen right: a woman doctor with glasses, dark hair tied back and a white lab coat sits at a desk with a pen, smiling kindly. On the wall behind her hangs a framed display of two bright RED boxing gloves with a small plaque beneath (the only red). Flat light.

shots.action: The DOCTOR, warm, pen ready.
shots.line: DOCTOR: So. Tell me about your symptoms.
shots.change: She invites the problem.
shots.prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, of a woman doctor in her forties with glasses, dark hair tied back and a white lab coat, warm kind smile, pen poised over a notepad, looking slightly off-lens to the left. Plain exam room wall behind. Soft flat light.

shots.action: HIM, facing her, a little too honest. His fingers drum the edge of the bed.
shots.line: HIM: Okay. So. I can't stop listening to music. Like, ever. In the shower. In my sleep.
shots.change: Symptom 1 of 3.
shots.prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, of a man in his thirties with short dark hair and a plain grey t-shirt sitting on an exam bed, talking earnestly, looking slightly off-lens to the right, one hand drumming fingers on the edge of the bed. Plain wall behind. Soft flat light.

shots.action: The DOCTOR nods, writes.
shots.line: HIM (o.s.): I tried silence once, and it was just... more music.
shots.change: Plant: silence = more music.
shots.prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, of a woman doctor with glasses, dark hair tied back and a white lab coat nodding and writing on a notepad, eyes down, polite neutral face. Plain wall behind. Soft flat light.

shots.action: HIM, lower, shy. Slow push-in: the confession is his.
shots.line: HIM: And, um. I'm in love. With a ghost.
shots.change: Symptom 2. The scene turns personal.
shots.prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, of a man with short dark hair and a plain grey t-shirt on an exam bed, looking down and to the side shyly, a small embarrassed half smile, shoulders in. Plain wall behind. Soft flat light.

shots.action: Her pen stops mid-word.
shots.line: HIM (o.s.): In space.
shots.change: Symptom 3. The first crack in her calm.
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up insert of a woman's hand holding a pen frozen mid-word on a notepad on a desk, the pen tip stopped on the paper. Top-down three-quarter angle, soft flat light, plain.

shots.action: The DOCTOR looks up at him. Blank. Hold. (The pause before the punchline.)
shots.change: The pause.
shots.prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, of a woman doctor with glasses, dark hair tied back and a white lab coat looking up from her notepad straight ahead with a completely blank, still face, pen lifted. Plain wall behind. Soft flat light, locked off.

shots.action: HIM, dreamy. He pulls a folded crayon drawing from his pocket and holds it up: a sheet ghost with no face.
shots.line: HIM: She doesn't have a face. But she has, like... a vibe.
shots.change: Plant: the faceless ghost, and the drawing he will carry to space.
shots.prompt: Close-up of a man with short dark hair and a plain grey t-shirt, dreamy half-lidded eyes looking up and away, holding up beside his face a folded piece of paper with a child-like crayon drawing of a simple white bedsheet ghost with no face. Plain wall behind, soft flat light.

shots.action: The DOCTOR, deadpan, writes it down.
shots.line: DOCTOR: A space ghost.
shots.change: She takes it in stride: she has seen this before.
shots.prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, of a woman doctor with glasses, dark hair tied back and a white lab coat, deadpan flat expression, writing one word on her notepad while looking at the patient off-lens. Plain wall, soft flat light.

shots.action: HIM, hearing it said back to him.
shots.line: HIM: ...Space ghost.
shots.change: The reaction is the punchline.
shots.prompt: Close-up, eye level, of a man with short dark hair and a plain grey t-shirt, small uncertain nod, eyes slightly wide, mouth a little open, as if hearing his own words. Plain blank exam room wall behind, nothing else in frame. Soft flat light.

shots.action: The boxing gloves on the wall, held 2 s. The plaque: GOLDEN GLOVES CHAMPION. We see it; he doesn't. The bomb under the table.
shots.change: Suspense: the audience now knows what the cure is.
shots.prompt: Insert shot, straight on: a framed wall display of two bright RED boxing gloves hanging by their laces inside a wooden frame (the only red), a small blank brass plaque centred beneath the gloves. Exam room wall, flat even light, square to camera.

shots.action: She smiles and slides a red can across the desk to him.
shots.line: DOCTOR: Hawkes Punch. Every day until the symptoms go away.
shots.change: Turn (+, for now): there is a cure. Plant: 'every day'.
shots.prompt: Over-the-shoulder medium shot from behind a seated man's grey-shirted shoulder, looking across a desk at a woman doctor with glasses and a white lab coat who smiles and slides a bright RED aluminium drink can across the desktop toward him (the only red). Exam room, soft flat light.

shots.action: The can in his hand, big enough to read: HAWKES PUNCH. One a day until it stops.
shots.change: Plant: the red can (the ad, the ending).
shots.prompt: Insert close-up of a man's hand holding a bright RED aluminium drink can up to camera, the can filling most of the frame, a plain label band with a simple fist icon, no text (the red is the only colour). Soft flat light, plain background.

shots.action: HIM, relieved, turns the can over.
shots.line: HIM: So I just... drink it?
shots.change: He hopes it is a drink.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, eye level, of a man with short dark hair and a grey t-shirt sitting on an exam bed, relieved hopeful face, turning a bright RED drink can over in his hands and reading it (the only red). Window behind him, soft flat light.

shots.action: Pause. She stands, takes off her glasses, and her eyes go to the gloves on the wall.
shots.line: DOCTOR: No.
shots.change: Turn begins (-): the cure is her fist.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, eye level, of a woman doctor in a white lab coat with dark hair tied back standing up from her desk, taking off her glasses with one hand, her eyes turned toward a framed pair of bright RED boxing gloves on the wall beside her (the only red). Calm, flat expression. Exam room, soft light.

shots.action: He follows her look to the gloves. Back to her.
shots.line: HIM (small): Oh no.
shots.change: He finally sees the bomb.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, eye level, of a man with short dark hair and a grey t-shirt sitting on an exam bed, head turned to look at something on the wall off-frame, face dropping into dawning dread, the red can slack in his hand (the only red). Soft flat light.

shots.action: The DOCTOR rolls her shoulders. Flat, calm, terrifying. The register switches: low angle, hard rim light.
shots.line: DOCTOR: Don't worry. It's only just a healthy amount of people in the world. You are just one of them. So shut up, and swallow the damn Hawkes Punch.
shots.change: Turn (-): hope to doom. The long build begins.
shots.prompt: Low angle medium close-up looking up at a woman doctor in a white lab coat, glasses off, dark hair tied back, rolling one shoulder, chin down, calm cold stare, hard rim light from behind, deep shadows, dramatic. Exam room ceiling behind her. Short lens, heroic framing.

shots.action: The wind-up, held: fist cocked behind her ear, torso twisted away, a tremble. He is in frame, within reach, frozen. Let the whole wind-up play in one shot.
shots.change: Anticipation. Both in one frame so the geography reads.
shots.prompt: Low three-quarter wide two-shot: a woman doctor in a white lab coat in a boxer's stance, right fist cocked back behind her ear, torso twisted, feet planted, screen right; screen left, a dark-haired man in a grey t-shirt sits frozen on an exam bed within arm's reach, eyes wide, holding a red can (the only red). Dramatic hard rim light, deep shadows, short lens, speed lines faint around her fist.

shots.action: The hit. Her fist meets his jaw: IMPACT FRAME, black on white, radial lines. Hitstop. The loudest sound in the film.
shots.line: (WHOOSH-CRACK)
shots.change: Resolution in 2 frames.
shots.prompt: Anime impact frame: a pure black-and-white high-contrast frame, a woman's fist in a white coat sleeve connecting with a man's jaw, his head snapping sideways, everything rendered as solid black silhouette on white paper with bold radial speed lines bursting from the point of contact. No grey, no red, graphic and flat.

shots.action: He rockets straight up through the ceiling. Tiles rain. She stands below, cold face, arm still extended.
shots.change: The cure administered. Her reaction (she owns the action).
shots.prompt: Wide shot of a doctor's exam room: a man in a grey t-shirt rockets straight up through a hole in the ceiling, legs trailing, ceiling tiles and dust raining down, a trail of speed lines; below, a woman doctor in a white lab coat stands with her punching arm still extended upward, calm cold face. Dramatic light, debris, motion lines.

shots.action: Reception. The TURKEY looks up at the rattling ceiling as dust falls. Looks back at its screen. Types.
shots.line: (a small ceiling rattle; then keyboard taps)
shots.change: The free laugh: the mundane reaction to the epic event.
shots.prompt: Medium shot, eye level, centred: a cartoon turkey in a small nurse's cap behind a reception desk looks straight up at the ceiling, a little dust drifting down onto it, one wing still on the keyboard. Clinic waiting room, flat light, locked off, deadpan.

shots.action: He streaks up through the clouds, screaming. The sky goes from blue to deep blue to stars. Camera tilts up with him.
shots.line: HIM: AAAAAAAAH—
shots.change: Clinic to space in one move.
shots.prompt: Wide shot looking up: a small man in a grey t-shirt streaks upward through broken clouds with a long bright trail and speed lines, arms flailing, mouth open screaming; the sky grades from pale at the bottom to near black with stars at the top. Dramatic, dynamic diagonal composition.

shots.action: The streak passes the Moon and sails toward Saturn, which grows from a dot to fill the frame. The instant he crosses the ring plane the scream cuts dead. He coasts to a stop, a tiny lit figure against the rings. Hold.
shots.line: HIM: —AAAH (cut dead)
shots.change: World rule: planets are real size, a man is a speck. Sound to silence.
shots.prompt: Extreme wide space shot: a vast Saturn with its rings fills the frame, lit hard from the left, rings seen edge-on at a shallow angle. A tiny human figure with a glowing trail and speed lines has just crossed into the ring plane and is coming to a stop, a small bright speck against the enormous rings. Deep black starfield. Epic scale, dramatic rim light.

shots.action: Lit by ring light. 'Silence.' Hold. '...Nope. More music.' A thought lands; slow push in. He pulls the drawing from his pocket and holds it up.
shots.line: HIM: Silence. (hold) ...Nope. More music. (beat) Wait. Space... She's up here.
shots.change: Payoff: silence = more music. He gets a goal: find her.
shots.prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, locked off: a man with short dark hair and a plain grey t-shirt floating in space, perfectly plain blank face, lit softly from one side by pale ring light, holding up beside his chest a flat folded sheet of paper on which is a crude crayon scribble of a white bedsheet ghost shape with absolutely no eyes and no mouth, just a blank sheet outline. Behind him a dim band of Saturn's rings and black starry space. Calm, centred, still.

shots.action: He peers round a house-sized ice boulder, drawing held up, looking screen LEFT. Behind him screen RIGHT the GHOST rises from behind another boulder and looks at him. He turns; she sinks. Twice. Then a tap on his shoulder from off-frame right. He freezes.
shots.line: HIM: ...Space ghost?
shots.change: Suspense: we see her, he doesn't. Then he is found, by the wrong one.
shots.prompt: Medium shot in space among huge pale ice boulders: screen left, a man with short dark hair and a grey t-shirt peers around a big ice boulder looking to the left, holding up a flat sheet of paper. Behind him, screen right, a small plain white bedsheet ghost with absolutely no eyes, no mouth, no face at all, just a smooth blank sheet, rises from behind another boulder, unnoticed. Saturn's rings stretch behind, black starry space. Flat even light, locked off.

shots.action: He turns: it is HIM, in a red tee, screen right. The DOUBLE looks at the drawing, then at him. Long deadpan hold. Then the double boops his nose, drifts back grinning, and leaves in a streak.
shots.line: DOUBLE: That's a sheet. / HIM: She has a vibe. / (boop)
shots.change: Rule of three broken: not the ghost, a double. He has company he didn't ask for.
shots.prompt: Centred two-shot in space, only two people: screen left, a man with short dark hair in a plain grey t-shirt and grey trousers; screen right, an identical man with the exact same face and hair wearing a bright RED t-shirt and grey trousers (the red shirt is the only red). Both float upright facing each other at arm's length with blank deadpan faces. The grey-shirt man holds up a flat sheet of paper with a crude crayon scribble of a blank sheet-ghost shape on it; the red-shirt man looks at the paper flatly. Nobody else in frame. Ice boulders and Saturn's rings behind, black space. Flat even light, symmetrical.

shots.line: HIM: Hey! Are you her?! / DOUBLE: No!
shots.change: His goal: catch him for an answer. He is as strong as the double.

shots.change: Power by accident: his flinch cracks a moon.

shots.action: From high orbit: two lit specks above the grey moon. A city-sized crater blooms under them, a slow shock ring, a dust plume. Then near silence.
shots.line: (a low rumble, then nothing)
shots.change: The scale cut: face to a dot against a world.
shots.prompt: Extreme wide shot from high orbit of a small grey cratered moon against black starry space, lit from the left; on its surface a fresh enormous crater is blooming with a glowing centre, an expanding circular shock ring across the surface and a rising plume of dust; two tiny glowing specks float just above it. Epic scale, dramatic, high contrast.

shots.action: Both float side by side and look down at the fresh crater filling the bottom of frame. Dust settles. 1.5 s hold before the line.
shots.line: HIM: ...That was there before. / DOUBLE: Sure.
shots.change: The bigger the feat, the smaller the reaction.
shots.prompt: Centred symmetrical two-shot, eye level, locked off: screen left a man in a plain grey t-shirt, screen right an identical man in a bright RED t-shirt (the only red), floating side by side in space, both looking straight down with blank deadpan faces at a huge fresh crater that fills the bottom of the frame, dust settling. Black starry space behind. Flat even light, still.

shots.action: The DOUBLE grips the edge of Saturn's ring and pulls: the whole ring lifts off like a hoop. He spins it overhead like a lasso and throws. The loop sails across and drops over JUPITER. He yanks. Jupiter starts to move.
shots.change: Escalation 3: a planet is coming.
shots.prompt: Extreme wide space shot, epic scale: a tiny glowing figure in a bright RED t-shirt (the only red) spins an entire planetary ring overhead like a lasso, the giant bright hoop of Saturn's ring flying as a loop across the frame toward a huge banded Jupiter on the right third, a faint dotted arc showing its path; Saturn, ringless, sits far left. Black starfield, hard light from the left, speed lines on the ring.

shots.action: Low on HIM, Jupiter filling the whole sky behind and coming at him. He braces, arms out, a tremble. CATCH: impact frame, hitstop, a shockwave across the cloud bands. He slides back thousands of km, heels carving speed lines in nothing.
shots.change: The finisher: the biggest hit in the film, a planet caught.
shots.prompt: Extreme low angle wide shot: a man in a grey t-shirt, seen from below, braces with both arms out and palms flat against the enormous banded cloud wall of Jupiter that fills the entire sky behind and above him, a bright flash and a huge circular shockwave rippling out across the cloud bands from his hands, speed lines streaming from his heels. shots.action: Palms flat on a wall of storm clouds, a hurricane bigger than Earth turning beside his head. Beat of 1.5 s. 'Okay.' He shoves it back where it was.
shots.line: HIM (calm): Okay.
shots.change: Payoff hold: he is unimpressed. The double has to go bigger.

Soft even light, calm, still, deadpan.

shots.line: HIM: Hey. / DOUBLE: What.

shots.action: Above Earth at sunrise, out of breath, face to face. 'Are you... the space ghost?' 'No, man. I'm you.' Pause. He looks at the double's face. 'You do have a face.' He looks at the drawing and lets it go. It drifts off toward the sunrise.

shots.action: Side by side. The drawing drifts past the GHOST, who catches it, looks at it, and seems pleased. Neither notices. He starts to turn; the double turns his chin back. Then both turn to camera with TV smiles.
shots.line: DOUBLE: Hey. Focus. (beat) Are you feeling like there's two of you?

shots.line: HIM: Well, I met someone, and he—
shots.change: The edge of the frame hides the punch. Payoff: he has a new symptom.
shots.prompt: Medium close-up, eye level, of a man with short dark hair and a grey t-shirt on an exam bed, dreamy smile, eyes up and away, mid-sentence; from the right edge of the frame a woman's fist in a white coat sleeve enters fast with speed lines, about to connect with his cheek. Plain wall, flat light, comic timing.

shots.action: A streak leaves the Earth again. He coasts in above it.
shots.change: Same time, same place.
shots.prompt: Extreme wide space shot, one continuous image filling the frame: the curved edge of planet Earth with a thin blue atmosphere glow across the bottom of the frame, and a single long bright streak with speed lines rising from it up into black starry space, a tiny glowing figure at its tip. Epic, clean, dramatic.
shots.style: One single frame from a greyscale animated film, full-bleed, filling the entire 16:9 image edge to edge with one scene. Clean ink lines, soft grey cel shading, exactly one accent colour: bright red, used only where noted. No comic panels, no grid, no borders, no split screen, no text, no letters, no watermark. Simple readable staging, clear silhouettes.

shots.action: The DOUBLE waits with two cans. HIM coasts in and takes one. Clink. They drink. Behind them, out of focus, the GHOST holds the drawing and waves at us.
shots.line: DOUBLE: Same time tomorrow?
shots.change: Payoff: the daily dose is a friend. The ghost waves at the audience.
shots.prompt: Two-shot in space above Earth: screen left a man in a grey t-shirt and screen right an identical man in a bright RED t-shirt clink two RED drink cans together (red only there), both relaxed and smiling; behind them, soft and out of focus, a small white faceless bedsheet ghost holding a folded paper drawing waves one sheet-corner at the camera. Black starry space, warm light, calm.

shots.action: Black. A red can rolls into frame. Stops.
shots.change: The last image is the product.
shots.prompt: Low close shot on a dark floor against pure black, one continuous image: a single bright RED aluminium drink can lying on its side in the lower right, rolled to a stop, a short faint motion trail behind it to the left (the red can is the only colour). Minimal, graphic, mostly empty black.
